ins-training.title: Camp ‘Abhyas- 21’ for Direct Entry Engineering Mechanic Course 60.948 was conducted at INS Shivaji from 17 to 19 December 2021. 196 trainees, including one international trainee from Maldives, participated in the camp. During the camp, trainees were exposed to various exercises including Damage Control and Firefighting exercise akin to how they would be challenged 'At Sea'. Pratapgad Division emerged as the 'Champion' of Camp Abhyas -21. Prashant Kalshan DEME was adjudged as the 'Best Trainee of the Camp' and Vishal Ugale DEME as the 'Most Spirited Trainee' of Camp Abhyas-21. Rear Admiral TVN Prasanna, CSO (Training) was the chief guest of the campfire.
